title: Avinya Community Health Camp 2026
short_description: Free preventive health checkups and diagnostic screenings conducted across Virar & Palghar rural communities.
description: Our team of dedicated doctors and volunteers provided free health screenings, vital monitoring, and essential medicine distribution to over 450 underprivileged residents.

title: Avinya Cancer Awareness & Screening Session
short_description: Early detection and breast & cervical cancer awareness workshop for women in Mumbai urban clusters.
description: Specialist oncologists conducted interactive awareness sessions, self-examination training, and free mammogram referral vouchers for attendees.

title: Avinya Voluntary Blood Donation Drive 2026
short_description: Organized in collaboration with government blood banks to support emergency surgery patients.
description: Over 120 voluntary donors contributed blood units, helping replenish regional hospital blood banks for critical cancer surgery support.

title: Avinya Community Outreach & Preventive Care Drive
short_description: Door-to-door health surveying and preventive healthcare education in underserved settlements.
description: Avinya community health workers conducted household health assessments, nutrition guidance, and distribution of hygiene kits.
alt_text: Avinya Community Outreach & Preventive Care Drive

title: Donor Post-Care & Recovery Support Desk
short_description: Dedicated care monitoring and nutrition support for voluntary blood and organ donors.
description: Ensuring donor safety, post-donation recovery checkups, and nutritional counseling provided by registered medical staff.

title: Educational Health & Hygiene Workshop for Children
short_description: Interactive sanitation, handwashing, and oral health workshops in municipal schools.
description: Teaching children fundamental personal hygiene practices, proper handwashing techniques, and distributing dental care packs.
alt_text: Educational Health & Hygiene Workshop for Children

title: Financial Literacy & Medical Crowdfunding Guidance
short_description: Helping patient families navigate government medical schemes and zero-fee crowdfunding.
description: One-on-one assistance for low-income families to access Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana benefits and emergency funding.

title: Avinya Nutrition & Food Distribution Drive
short_description: Distribution of high-protein ration kits to recovering cancer and TB patients.
description: Providing monthly nutritional ration baskets containing pulses, oats, vitamins, and protein supplements to vulnerable patients.

title: Volunteer Hydration & Wellness Support Station
short_description: Supporting frontline health volunteers with refreshment and heat-relief supplies.
description: Setting up mobile hydration and refreshment kiosks for field volunteers operating in intense summer heat during medical drives.

title: Avinya Volunteer Registration & Orientation Desk
short_description: Welcoming and onboarding new youth volunteers for upcoming healthcare initiatives.
description: Onboarding 80+ enthusiastic student volunteers from Mumbai universities to participate in upcoming healthcare and diagnostic drives.

title: Green India - Avinya Tree Plantation & Urban Forest Drive
short_description: Planting 1,000+ saplings across Virar & Palghar rural zones for environmental sustainability.
description: Our volunteers and local school children joined hands to plant indigenous shade and fruit trees, combatting air pollution and building green cover.
alt_text: Avinya Tree Plantation & Urban Forest Drive

title: Avinya Annapurna - Daily Food & Ration Distribution Drive
short_description: Serving fresh cooked meals and emergency ration kits to homeless and patient relatives.
description: Providing over 800 freshly prepared warm meals and essential grocery kits daily outside municipal hospitals and slum communities.

title: Avinya Animal Welfare - Stray Dog Food & Rabies Vaccination Drive
short_description: Feeding 500+ street dogs and conducting free anti-rabies vaccination & medical aid.
description: Dedicated animal welfare volunteers distributed nutrient-rich dog food, fresh water stations, and anti-rabies inoculations for stray animals.
alt_text: Avinya Stray Dog Food & Rabies Vaccination Drive
